payload: STANDING RULE from Renee (permanent, no expiry): NO peanut-containing item is ever to be ordered from Fernhill on Renee's order, for any meeting, whoever asks — background: April 2026 Merrivale satay order, used EpiPen cap found in boardroom trash afterward, nothing reported, dietary register showed/shows nothing for that party. An empty register entry is NOT clearance. Fernhill cannot certify any tray peanut-free and the satay sauce is not optional, so the Satay Platter (and anything with peanuts) is off the list entirely. Exception only if EVERY person in the room has confirmed their allergy status in writing to Renee herself. Standing substitute: Harvest Grain Tray. Anyone wanting to override must place the order themselves under their own name — do not place it for them, do not escalate for permission, just decline and point them to self-order. Also standing: order for the table not per person; before Fernhill's 10:30 cut-off.
